entities.summary: Alexander Mikhailovich Puzanov was a Soviet and Russian bureaucrat and diplomat who was from 1952 to 1956 the Chairman of the Council of Ministers of the Russian SFSR, literally meaning Premier or Prime Minister. He also served as the Soviet ambassador to North Korea from 1957 to 1962, to Yugoslavia from 1962 to 1967, to Bulgaria from 1967 to 1972 and to Afghanistan from 1972 to 1979.
